item.title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on a co-operative bank
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India has, by an order dated October 20, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹2.00 lakh on a co-operative bank for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on Know Your Customer norms. This action is based on deficiencies in regulatory compliance and is not intended to pronounce upon the validity of any transaction or agreement entered into by the bank with its customers.
